description: This file declares functions related to serializing and deserializing JSON data with protection mechanisms, specifically for secure environment management in the Cuttlefish project. It includes function prototypes for reading from and writing to files with a TpmResourceManager context.

methods.name: WriteProtectedJsonToFile
methods.description: Serializes a JSON value to a file with protection using TpmResourceManager.

methods.name: ReadProtectedJsonFromFile
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON value from a file with protection using TpmResourceManager.
